item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen po'i rgyud las rigs drug gnas 'dren thar lam them skas
item.coloph: ces zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus bar do thos chog rang grol chen po'i rgyud las/ thugs rje chen po'i rigs drug gnas 'dren thar lam them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dus snyigs ma'i kho bo rig 'dzin g.yung drung gling pa bdag gis/ rang don 'di gtad kyi rig pa 'chal ba mtha' dang bral kyang / gzhan don rgyal khams kyi dang gshin ro ska bo myang ba'i dus su/ dbyibs klong gong yongs zhes pa'i sa char/ 'brog sbyin tshe brtan du 'bod pa tshe 'phos tshe mkho mar byung nas/ 'phral du sug bris bgyis pa 'dis kyang / bstan pa'i rgyan dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig/
